S1 · ORBIT

Three cards orbit a circle. All faces stay toward you.

Three premium cards on a circular orbit in the vertical plane. At rest, MAILBOX faces you at the front (closest), Family and Teams sit above and below on the wheel (further back, smaller due to perspective). Hover — all three cards travel around the circle together, one full revolution every 9 seconds. Cards always face the viewer (like ferris-wheel seats staying upright), so you never lose sight of any tier.

S2 · STACK CASCADE

All-light cascade, one card promoted

Pure light-theme interpretation. All three cards are paper-white; two "behind" cards sit slightly smaller and dimmer above, the recommended card is full-width, ringed in blue, and populated. Same layered idea as your reference, but no dark cards anywhere — reads more Apple-store than Dribbble.

S3 · STACK LEDGER

Expanded card on top, quiet ledger beneath
